title: Most Energy-Efficient Supercomputers: Green500 June 2026
desc: The top ten systems in the June 2026 Green500 list, ranked by energy efficiency on the High Performance Linpack benchmark. This covers eligible TOP500 submissions, not every supercomputer worldwide; some entries are system partitions.

source.name: TOP500 — Green500 June 2026 list
source.note: Verified by the AllRanks assistant on 2026-10-30 against the linked official June 2026 Green500 table: compared all ten system names, countries, ranks and energy efficiency values in GFlops/watt. The list covers eligible TOP500 submissions rather than all supercomputers; entries can represent partitions, and benchmark efficiency is not a measure of total energy consumption.
